title: Environment Module Showcase
one_sentence: A modular room shell assembled from reusable Wonder environment modules.
source_prompt: A modular room shell assembled from floor tiles, wall segments, arches, platforms, stairs, background silhouettes, and terrain chunks.

intent.setting: A compact room shell that demonstrates modular environment composition.
intent.emotional_goal: The first view should feel like a buildable place rather than a prop collection.
intent.primary_interaction: Inspect the room shell and terrain edge to choose expansion directions.
intent.spatial_logic: A boundary shell contains floor, wall, ceiling, arch, platform, stair, background, and terrain modules on a snap grid.

style.lighting: Soft debug lighting keeps snap-grid modules readable.

required_elements.description: A scene boundary shell that preserves continuity for expansion.
Floor, wall, and ceiling modules aligned to the same snap grid.
Arch, platform, and stair modules that describe traversal.
Terrain and background modules that hint at exterior expansion.

camera_intents.purpose: Show the modular room shell and terrain edge.

curiosity_goals: Where can the room shell expand next?
What lies beyond the terrain transition?
authoring_notes: Phase 26 environment module fixture. Modules are planning vocabulary; mesh runtime proof is separate.
